principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for holding order data as well as managing order state, while the PaymentProcessor classes are responsible for payment processing. The management of the order state should be separated from payment processing.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate order management and payment processing into distinct classes.

principle_violations.reason: To add new payment processing types, the existing classes have to be modified directly, which violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use a factory method to instantiate payment processors, allowing for new payment methods to be added without modifying existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
